<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>for you — seven notes</title>
<link rel="icon" href="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 40 40'%3E%3Ccircle cx='20' cy='20' r='18' fill='%23A8543C'/%3E%3Ctext x='20' y='27' font-size='20' text-anchor='middle' fill='white' font-family='Georgia,serif' font-style='italic'%3E%26%23x2661;%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,400;0,600;1,500&family=Homemade+Apple&family=Jost:wght@300;400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root{
    --beige: #ECE3D2;
    --beige-deep: #DED0B4;
    --paper: #FBF7EC;
    --paper-shadow: #C9BB9C;
    --ink: #3B3226;
    --ink-soft: #6B5D49;
    --seal: #A8543C;
    --sage: #8A9575;
    --gold: #B08D57;
    --rose: #B5716A;
    --grain: radial-gradient(rgba(59,50,38,0.05) 1px, transparent 1px);
  }
  *{ box-sizing: border-box; margin:0; padding:0; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
  html,body{ height:100%; }
  body.lock-active{ overflow: hidden; height: 100%; position: fixed; width: 100%; }
  body{
    font-family:'Jost', sans-serif;
    color: var(--ink);
    background: var(--beige);
    overflow-x:hidden;
    -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%;
  }
  button{ font-family:inherit; cursor:pointer; touch-action: manipulation; }
  button, .envelope, .garden-screen, .garden-hint, .flower-wrap,
  .desk, .cal-day, .activity-option, .photo-grid img, .p-node{
    -webkit-user-select: none; user-select: none;
    -webkit-touch-callout: none;
  }
  textarea, input{ -webkit-user-select: text; user-select: text; }

  /* floating dust particles */
  #dust{ position:fixed; inset:0; pointer-events:none; z-index:1; overflow:hidden; transition: transform .4s ease-out; }
  .mote{
    position:absolute;
    width:3px; height:3px;
    border-radius:50%;
    background: var(--gold);
    opacity:.25;
    animation: drift linear infinite;
  }
  @keyframes drift{
    from{ transform: translateY(110vh) translateX(0); opacity:0; }
    10%{ opacity:.3; }
    90%{ opacity:.2; }
    to{ transform: translateY(-10vh) translateX(20px); opacity:0; }
  }

  /* ambient glow that trails scroll/mouse, sits behind everything */
  #ambientGlow{
    position: fixed; left:50%; top:40%;
    width: 560px; height:560px; border-radius:50%;
    background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(176,141,87,0.16), transparent 70%);
    transform: translate(-50%,-50%);
    pointer-events:none; z-index:0;
    will-change: transform;
  }

  /* cursor ink trail */
  .trail-dot{
    position:fixed; width:5px; height:5px; border-radius:50%;
    background: var(--seal); opacity:.3; pointer-events:none; z-index:40;
    transform: translate(-50%,-50%);
    animation: trailFade .7s ease forwards;
  }
  @keyframes trailFade{
    to{ opacity:0; transform: translate(-50%,-50%) scale(.2); }
  }

  /* click-released petal */
  .click-petal{
    position:fixed; pointer-events:none; z-index:40;
    font-size: 14px; opacity:.85;
    animation: petalRise 1.4s ease-out forwards;
  }
  @keyframes petalRise{
    to{ transform: translateY(-60px) translateX(var(--px, 10px)) rotate(120deg); opacity:0; }
  }

  /* body background transitions smoothly as she progresses */
  body{ transition: background-color 1.4s ease; }

  /* subtle breathing shimmer on paper grain */
  .pinned-note, .letter-paper, .calendar, .confirm-card, .activity-option, .ask-card{
    animation: grainDrift 9s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
  }
  @keyframes grainDrift{
    from{ background-position: 0 0; }
    to{ background-position: 2.5px 2.5px; }
  }

  /* ---------- LOCK SCREEN ---------- */
  #lock{
    position:fixed; inset:0;
    display:flex;
    z-index:50;
  }
  .lock-half{
    width:50%; height:100%; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; position:relative;
    transition: transform 0.9s cubic-bezier(.6,0,.2,1), opacity 0.9s ease;
    overflow-y: auto;
  }
  #lock.hidden .lock-left{ transform: translateX(-105%); }
  #lock.hidden .lock-right{ transform: translateX(105%); }
  #lock.gone{ visibility:hidden; pointer-events:none; }
  .lock-left{ background: var(--beige); border-right: 1px dashed var(--paper-shadow); }
  .lock-right{ background: var(--beige-deep); }

  .lock-flowers{
    position:absolute; bottom: 14px; left:0; right:0;
    display:flex; justify-content:center; gap: 14px;
    pointer-events:none; opacity:.92;
  }
  .lock-flowers img{
    width: 42px; height:auto;
    filter: drop-shadow(0 4px 6px rgba(59,50,38,0.25));
  }

  .pinned-note{
    width: 78%; max-width: 360px;
    background-color: var(--paper);
    background-image: var(--grain);
    background-size: 3px 3px;
    padding: 46px 34px;
    box-shadow: 0 18px 40px -18px rgba(59,50,38,0.45);
    transform: rotate(-2.5deg);
    position: relative;
    clip-path: polygon(0.5% 2%, 8% 0%, 20% 1%, 33% 0%, 47% 1%, 60% 0%, 74% 1%, 88% 0%, 99.5% 2%, 100% 12%, 99% 25%, 100% 40%, 99.3% 55%, 100% 70%, 99% 85%, 100% 96%, 90% 99%, 76% 100%, 62% 99%, 48% 100%, 34% 99%, 20% 100%, 8% 99%, 0% 96%, 1% 82%, 0% 66%, 1% 50%, 0% 34%, 1% 18%);
  }
  .pinned-note::before{
    content:""; position:absolute; top:-14px; left:50%; transform: translateX(-50%);
    width:22px; height:22px; border-radius:50%;
    background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%, #d98a6f, var(--seal));
    box-shadow: 0 3px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
  }
  .pinned-note h1{
    font-family:'Cormorant Garamond', serif; font-weight:600; font-style:italic;
    font-size: 1.5rem; letter-spacing:.02em; margin-bottom: 18px; color: var(--ink);
  }
  .pinned-note p{
    font-family:'Homemade Apple', cursive; font-size: 1.3rem; line-height: 1.75; color: var(--ink-soft);
  }
  .pinned-note .sign{
    margin-top: 22px; text-align:right; font-family:'Homemade Apple', cursive;
    font-size: 1.5rem; color: var(--seal);
  }

  .pass-wrap{ text-align:center; width: 78%; max-width: 320px; }
  .pass-wrap .eyebrow{
    font-size:.72rem; letter-spacing:.28em; text-transform:uppercase; color: var(--ink-soft); margin-bottom: 10px;
  }
  .pass-wrap h2{
    font-family:'Cormorant Garamond', serif; font-size: 1.9rem; font-weight:600;
    margin-bottom: 28px; color: var(--ink);
  }
  .shake{ animation: shake 0.45s; }
  @keyframes shake{
    10%,90%{ transform: translateX(-2px); }
    20%,80%{ transform: translateX(4px); }
    30%,50%,70%{ transform: translateX(-8px); }
    40%,60%{ transform: translateX(8px); }
  }

  /* padlock combination lock */
  .padlock{ position: relative; width: 240px; margin: 0 auto; }
  .shackle{
    width: 90px; height: 90px; margin: 0 auto -34px;
    border: 14px solid var(--gold);
    border-bottom-color: transparent;
    border-radius: 50% 50% 0 0 / 60% 60% 0 0;
    position: relative; z-index: 1;
    box-shadow: 0 2px 3px rgba(59,50,38,0.25);
    transition: transform .5s cubic-bezier(.34,1.4,.64,1), opacity .4s ease;
    transform-origin: 80% 100%;
  }
  .shackle.open{ transform: translateX(18px) rotate(35deg); }
  .lock-body{
    background: linear-gradient(160deg, #C9A15E, var(--gold) 55%, #93733D);
    border-radius: 14px;
    padding: 22px 14px 18px;
    box-shadow: 0 14px 28px -14px rgba(59,50,38,0.5), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
    position: relative; z-index: 2;
  }
  .wheels{ display:flex; justify-content:center; gap: 8px; }
  .wheel{
    display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; gap: 6px;
    background: rgba(59,50,38,0.15);
    border-radius: 6px; padding: 6px 4px;
  }
  .wheel-btn{
    background:none; border:none; color: #FBF7EC; font-size: .7rem;
    width: 26px; height: 20px; line-height:1; opacity:.85;
  }
  .wheel-btn:hover{ opacity:1; color:#fff; }
  .wheel-digit{
    width: 30px; height: 38px; background: var(--paper);
    border-radius: 4px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    font-family:'Cormorant Garamond', serif; font-size: 1.4rem; color: var(--ink);
    box-shadow: inset 0 2px 4px rgba(59,50,38,0.3);
  }
  .wheel-digit.bump{ animation: digitBump .18s ease; }
  @keyframes digitBump{ 50%{ transform: scale(1.15); } }
  .padlock.error .lock-body{ animation: shake 0.45s; }

  .hint{ margin-top: 22px; font-size: .78rem; color: var(--ink-soft); letter-spacing:.03em; line-height:1.7; }
  .hint-sub{ font-size: .68rem; opacity: .7; font-style: italic; }

  @media (max-width: 720px){
    #lock{ flex-direction: column; }
    .lock-half{ width:100%; height:50%; }
    .lock-left{ border-right:none; border-bottom:1px dashed var(--paper-shadow); }
    .pinned-note{ transform: rotate(-1.2deg); padding: 30px 24px; }
    .pinned-note p{ font-size: 1.1rem; }
  }

  /* ---------- LETTERS SCREEN ---------- */
  #letters{ min-height:100vh; padding: 60px 20px 110px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; position:relative; z-index:2; }
  #letters h1{
    font-family:'Cormorant Garamond', serif; font-style:italic; font-weight:600;
    font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 4vw, 2.6rem); margin-bottom: 8px; text-align:center;
  }
  #letters .sub{
    color: var(--ink-soft); font-size:.85rem; letter-spacing:.08em; text-transform:uppercase;
    margin-bottom: 34px; text-align:center;
  }

  /* progress bar */
  .progress{
    display:flex; align-items:center; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 50px;
    font-family:'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
  }
  .p-node{
    width: 34px; height:34px; border-radius:50%;
    border: 1.5px solid var(--paper-shadow);
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    font-size: .95rem; color: var(--ink-soft);
    background: var(--paper);
    transition: all .3s ease;
  }
  .p-node.current{ border-color: var(--seal); color: var(--seal); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(168,84,60,0.12); }
  .p-node.done{ background: var(--sage); border-color: var(--sage); color:#fff; }
  .p-line{ width: 26px; height:1px; background: var(--paper-shadow); }
  .p-line.done{ background: var(--sage); }

  .desk{
    display:grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(190px, 1fr));
    gap: 34px; max-width: 980px; width:100%;
    transition: transform .2s ease-out;
    will-change: transform;
  }
  .envelope{
    background: var(--paper); border: 1px solid var(--paper-shadow); aspect-ratio: 4/3;
    position:relative; box-shadow: 0 14px 30px -16px rgba(59,50,38,0.4); cursor:pointer;
    transform: rotate(var(--tilt)); transition: transform .25s ease, box-shadow .25s ease, opacity .3s ease;
  }
  .envelope:nth-child(1){ --tilt:-3deg; }
  .envelope:nth-child(2){ --tilt:2deg; }
  .envelope:nth-child(3){ --tilt:-1.5deg; }
  .envelope:nth-child(4){ --tilt:2.5deg; }
  .envelope:nth-child(5){ --tilt:-2deg; }
  .envelope:hover{ transform: rotate(0deg) translateY(-6px); box-shadow: 0 22px 36px -14px rgba(59,50,38,0.5); }
  .envelope::before{
    content:""; position:absolute; inset:0;
    background:
      linear-gradient(135deg, transparent 49.3%, var(--paper-shadow) 49.6%, var(--paper-shadow) 50.4%, transparent 50.7%),
      linear-gradient(-135deg, transparent 49.3%, var(--paper-shadow) 49.6%, var(--paper-shadow) 50.4%, transparent 50.7%);
    background-size: 100% 65%, 100% 65%; background-position: top, top; background-repeat: no-repeat; opacity:.55;
    transition: transform .5s ease;
    transform-origin: top;
  }
  .envelope .seal{
    position:absolute; top:50%; left:50%; transform: translate(-50%,-50%);
    width: 40px; height:40px; border-radius:50%;
    background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%, #d98a6f, var(--seal));
    box-shadow: 0 3px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; color:#fff;
    font-family:'Cormorant Garamond', serif; font-size:1.05rem; font-style:italic;
    transition: opacity .3s ease, transform .3s ease;
  }
  .envelope .seal::after{
    content:""; position:absolute; inset:-7px; border-radius:50%;
    border: 1px dotted rgba(168,84,60,0.4);
    animation: spin 40s linear infinite;
  }
  @keyframes spin{ to{ transform: rotate(360deg); } }
  .envelope .num{
    position:absolute; bottom:14px; left:16px; font-size:.72rem; letter-spacing:.15em;
    text-transform:uppercase; color: var(--ink-soft);
  }
  .envelope.locked{ opacity:.45; cursor:not-allowed; }
  .envelope.locked:hover{ transform: rotate(var(--tilt)); box-shadow: 0 14px 30px -16px rgba(59,50,38,0.4); }
  .envelope.locked .lockicon{
    position:absolute; top:14px; right:16px; font-size:.85rem; color: var(--ink-soft);
  }
  .envelope.opening::before{ transform: rotateX(-165deg); }
  .envelope.opening .seal{ opacity:0; transform: translate(-50%,-50%) scale(.4); }
  .envelope.bonus{ border-color: var(--gold); }
  .envelope.bonus .seal{ background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%, #d7b271, var(--gold)); }
  .envelope.reveal-bonus{ animation: bonusIn .9s ease forwards; }
  @keyframes bonusIn{
    from{ opacity:0; transform: translateY(20px) rotate(var(--tilt)) scale(.9); }
    to{ opacity:1; transform: translateY(0) rotate(var(--tilt)) scale(1); }
  }

  /* modal letter */
  #overlay{
    position:fixed; inset:0; background: rgba(59,50,38,0.55);
    display:none; align-items:center; justify-content:center; z-index: 60; padding: 24px;
    opacity:0; transition: opacity .35s ease;
  }
  #overlay.show{ display:flex; }
  #overlay.show.in{ opacity:1; }
  .letter-paper{
    background-color: var(--paper);
    background-image: var(--grain);
    background-size: 3px 3px;
    width: 100%; max-width: 500px; max-height: 82vh; overflow-y:auto;
    padding: 48px 40px; position:relative; box-shadow: 0 30px 60px -20px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
    transform: translateY(28px) scale(.97); opacity:0; transition: all .4s ease;
    clip-path: polygon(0.5% 1.5%, 10% 0%, 22% 1%, 35% 0%, 49% 1%, 63% 0%, 77% 1%, 90% 0%, 99.5% 1.5%, 100% 10%, 99.2% 22%, 100% 35%, 99.4% 48%, 100% 62%, 99.2% 75%, 100% 88%, 99.5% 98.5%, 88% 100%, 74% 99%, 60% 100%, 46% 99%, 32% 100%, 18% 99%, 5% 100%, 0.5% 92%, 1.3% 78%, 0% 64%, 1.2% 50%, 0% 36%, 1% 22%, 0% 10%);
  }
  #overlay.in .letter-paper{ transform: translateY(0) scale(1); opacity:1; }
  .letter-paper h2{
    font-family:'Cormorant Garamond', serif; font-style:italic; font-size: 1.5rem;
    margin-bottom: 20px; color: var(--seal); min-height:1.8rem;
  }
  .letter-paper .body-text{
    font-family:'Homemade Apple', cursive; font-size: 1.28rem; line-height: 1.85; color: var(--ink);
    white-space: pre-wrap;
  }
  .close-btn{
    position:absolute; top:16px; right:18px; background:none; border:none;
    font-size:1.3rem; color: var(--ink-soft); line-height:1;
  }
  .close-btn:hover{ color: var(--seal); }
  .skip-btn{
    margin-top: 22px; background:none; border:1px solid var(--paper-shadow); color: var(--ink-soft);
    font-size:.72rem; letter-spacing:.1em; text-transform:uppercase; padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 20px;
  }
  .skip-btn:hover{ border-color: var(--seal); color: var(--seal); }
  .next-hint{ margin-top: 26px; font-size:.78rem; color: var(--ink-soft); font-style:italic; }

  /* final letter special */
  .pre-final{ text-align:center; }
  .pre-final p{ font-family:'Cormorant Garamond', serif; font-style:italic; font-size:1.25rem; margin-bottom:14px; color: var(--ink); }
  .go-btn{
    margin-top: 18px; background: var(--seal); color:#fff; border:none; padding: 12px 26px;
    border-radius: 30px; font-size:.85rem; letter-spacing:.05em;
  }
  .go-btn:hover{ background:#8f4531; }
  .go-btn.ghost{ background:none; border:1px solid var(--paper-shadow); color: var(--ink-soft); }
  .go-btn.ghost:hover{ border-color: var(--seal); color: var(--seal); }

  .question-block{ margin-top: 30px; text-align:center; }
  .question-block .q{
    font-family:'Cormorant Garamond', serif; font-style:italic; font-size: 1.5rem; margin-bottom: 22px; color: var(--seal);
  }
  .q-buttons{ display:flex; gap: 14px; justify-content:center; flex-wrap:wrap; }
  .answer-msg{ margin-top: 20px; font-family:'Homemade Apple', cursive; font-size:1.3rem; color: var(--ink-soft); }

  /* date invite / calendar / activity / confirm */
  .date-invite .go-btn{ margin: 8px 6px 0; }
  .calendar{
    margin: 20px auto 6px; max-width: 280px;
    background-color: var(--paper); background-image: var(--grain); background-size: 3px 3px;
    border: 1px solid var(--paper-shadow); padding: 18px 16px 16px; border-radius: 4px;
    position: relative; box-shadow: 0 10px 24px -14px rgba(59,50,38,0.35);
  }
  .calendar::before{
    content:""; position:absolute; top:-3px; left:50%; transform: translateX(-50%) rotate(-1.5deg);
    width: 60px; height:14px; background: var(--sage); opacity:.55;
  }
  .cal-header{
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between;
    font-family:'Cormorant Garamond', serif; font-size:1.05rem; margin-bottom:10px; color: var(--ink);
  }
  .cal-nav{ background:none; border:none; font-size:1.2rem; color: var(--ink-soft); width:28px; height:28px; }
  .cal-nav:hover{ color: var(--seal); }
  .cal-weekdays{
    display:grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(7,1fr); font-size:.65rem; color: var(--ink-soft);
    text-transform:uppercase; margin-bottom:6px;
  }
  .cal-weekdays span{ text-align:center; }
  .cal-grid{ display:grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(7,1fr); gap:4px; }
  .cal-day{ aspect-ratio:1; border:none; background:transparent; border-radius:6px; font-size:.85rem; color: var(--ink); }
  .cal-day:not(.empty):not(.disabled):hover{ background: var(--beige-deep); }
  .cal-day.disabled{ color: var(--paper-shadow); cursor:not-allowed; }
  .cal-day.empty{ pointer-events:none; }

  .activity-grid{ display:grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap:14px; margin-top:20px; text-align:left; }
  .activity-option{
    background-color: var(--paper); background-image: var(--grain); background-size: 3px 3px;
    border: 1px solid var(--paper-shadow); border-left: 3px solid var(--rose); border-radius:2px;
    padding:12px 14px; text-align:left; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:4px;
    box-shadow: 0 8px 16px -12px rgba(59,50,38,0.4);
    transform: rotate(var(--r, 0deg));
    transition: transform .2s ease, border-color .2s ease;
  }
  .activity-option:nth-child(odd){ --r: -0.8deg; }
  .activity-option:nth-child(even){ --r: 0.8deg; }
  .activity-option strong{ font-family:'Cormorant Garamond', serif; font-size:1rem; color: var(--ink); }
  .activity-option span{ font-size:.75rem; color: var(--ink-soft); }
  .activity-option:hover{ border-left-color: var(--seal); transform: rotate(0deg) translateY(-2px); }
  @media (max-width:480px){
    .activity-grid{ grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .progress{ gap:4px; flex-wrap:wrap; justify-content:center; margin-bottom:36px; }
    .p-node{ width:24px; height:24px; font-size:.7rem; }
    .p-line{ width:10px; }
    .padlock{ width: 208px; }
    .wheel-digit{ width:26px; height:34px; font-size:1.2rem; }
    .wheel-btn{ width:22px; }
    .letter-paper{ padding: 34px 24px; }
    .ask-card{ padding: 32px 24px; }
    .extras-menu{ margin-top:28px; }
  }

  .confirm-card{
    background-color: var(--paper); background-image: var(--grain); background-size: 3px 3px;
    border: 1px solid var(--paper-shadow); border-radius:4px; padding:22px 20px; max-width:300px; margin:0 auto;
    position:relative; box-shadow: 0 10px 24px -14px rgba(59,50,38,0.35);
  }
  .confirm-card::before{
    content:""; position:absolute; top:-3px; left:50%; transform: translateX(-50%) rotate(1.5deg);
    width: 60px; height:14px; background: var(--rose); opacity:.55;
  }
  .confirm-row{ display:flex; justify-content:space-between; padding:8px 0; font-size:.9rem; border-bottom:1px dashed var(--paper-shadow); }
  .confirm-row:last-child{ border-bottom:none; }
  .confirm-row span{ color: var(--ink-soft); }

  /* celebration */
  #confetti{ position:fixed; inset:0; pointer-events:none; z-index:70; overflow:hidden; }
  .petal{
    position:absolute; top:-20px; font-size: 1rem; opacity:.9;
    animation: fall linear forwards;
  }
  @keyframes fall{
    to{ transform: translateY(105vh) rotate(360deg); opacity:.2; }
  }

  /* sparse background petal drift — envelope grid page only */
  .bg-petal{
    position: fixed; top: -30px; pointer-events: none; z-index: 1;
    border-radius: 60% 60% 60% 0;
    opacity: 0;
    animation: bgPetalFall linear forwards;
  }
  @keyframes bgPetalFall{
    0%{ transform: translate(0,0) rotate(0deg); opacity: 0; }
    8%{ opacity: .38; }
    28%{ transform: translate(-16px, 28vh) rotate(60deg); }
    52%{ transform: translate(12px, 52vh) rotate(140deg); }
    76%{ transform: translate(-10px, 76vh) rotate(230deg); }
    92%{ opacity: .28; }
    100%{ transform: translate(8px, 108vh) rotate(320deg); opacity: 0; }
  }

  /* occasional glowing butterfly, drifting across the screen */
  .butterfly{
    position: fixed; pointer-events: none; z-index: 3;
    filter: drop-shadow(0 0 4px rgba(255,205,120,0.6)) drop-shadow(0 0 8px rgba(255,180,90,0.4));
    animation: butterflyFly linear forwards;
  }
  @keyframes butterflyFly{
    0%{ transform: translate(0, 0); opacity: 0; }
    6%{ opacity: .95; }
    20%{ transform: translate(22vw, -26px); }
    40%{ transform: translate(44vw, 18px); }
    60%{ transform: translate(66vw, -22px); }
    80%{ transform: translate(88vw, 14px); }
    94%{ opacity: .9; }
    100%{ transform: translate(112vw, -6px); opacity: 0; }
  }
  .butterfly .wing{ transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: center right; }
  .butterfly .wing-l{ animation: flapL .28s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
  .butterfly .wing-r{ animation: flapR .28s ease-in-out infinite alternate; transform-origin: center left; }
  @keyframes flapL{ from{ transform: scaleX(1); } to{ transform: scaleX(.45); } }
  @keyframes flapR{ from{ transform: scaleX(1); } to{ transform: scaleX(.45); } }

  /* sound toggle */
  #soundToggle{
    position: fixed; top: 18px; right: 18px; z-index: 80;
    width: 38px; height:38px; border-radius:50%;
    background: var(--paper); border: 1px solid var(--paper-shadow);
    color: var(--ink-soft); font-size: .95rem;
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    box-shadow: 0 6px 14px -8px rgba(59,50,38,0.4);
  }
  #soundToggle.on{ color: var(--seal); border-color: var(--seal); }

  /* ask me anything */
  #askLink{
    margin-top: 54px; background:none; border:none;
    font-family:'Cormorant Garamond', serif; font-style:italic; font-size:1.05rem;
    color: var(--ink-soft); border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--paper-shadow); padding-bottom:3px;
  }
  #askLink:hover{ color: var(--seal); border-color: var(--seal); }
  .ask-screen{
    position:fixed; inset:0; background: rgba(59,50,38,0.55);
    display:none; align-items:center; justify-content:center; z-index:65; padding:24px;
    opacity:0; transition: opacity .35s ease;
  }
  .ask-screen.show{ display:flex; }
  .ask-screen.show.in{ opacity:1; }
  .ask-card{
    background-color: var(--paper); background-image: var(--grain); background-size: 3px 3px;
    width:100%; max-width: 440px; padding: 44px 36px; position:relative;
    box-shadow: 0 30px 60px -20px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
    transform: translateY(28px) scale(.97); opacity:0; transition: all .4s ease;
  }
  .ask-screen.in .ask-card{ transform: translateY(0) scale(1); opacity:1; }
  .ask-card h2{
    font-family:'Cormorant Garamond', serif; font-style:italic; font-size:1.5rem; color: var(--seal); margin-bottom:8px;
  }
  .ask-sub{ font-size:.85rem; color: var(--ink-soft); margin-bottom:20px; }
  #askText{
    width:100%; padding:14px; border:1px solid var(--paper-shadow); background: var(--beige);
    font-family:'Jost', sans-serif; font-size:.95rem; color: var(--ink); resize:vertical;
    border-radius:4px;
  }
  #askText:focus{ outline:none; border-color: var(--seal); }

  /* garden */
  #gardenLink{
    margin-top: 10px; background:none; border:none;
    font-family:'Cormorant Garamond', serif; font-style:italic; font-size:1.05rem;
    color: var(--ink-soft); border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--paper-shadow); padding-bottom:3px;
  }
  #gardenLink:hover{ color: var(--sage); border-color: var(--sage); }
  #gardenCloseBtn{ right: 64px; z-index: 66; }

  /* extras menu (dropdown) */
  .extras-menu{ margin-top: 40px; position: relative; display:flex; justify-content:center; }
  #extrasToggle{
    background: var(--paper); border: 1px solid var(--paper-shadow); border-radius: 20px;
    padding: 8px 20px; font-family:'Cormorant Garamond', serif; font-style:italic; font-size:1rem;
    color: var(--ink-soft); box-shadow: 0 6px 14px -10px rgba(59,50,38,0.4);
    display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px;
  }
  #extrasToggle:hover{ color: var(--seal); border-color: var(--seal); }
  #extrasToggle .chev{ transition: transform .25s ease; font-size:.85rem; }
  .extras-menu.open #extrasToggle .chev{ transform: rotate(180deg); }
  .extras-dropdown{
    position: absolute; top: calc(100% + 8px); left:50%; transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(-6px);
    background-color: var(--paper); background-image: var(--grain); background-size: 3px 3px;
    border: 1px solid var(--paper-shadow); border-radius: 8px;
    min-width: 200px; padding: 6px;
    box-shadow: 0 16px 30px -14px rgba(59,50,38,0.45);
    display:flex; flex-direction:column;
    opacity:0; pointer-events:none; transition: opacity .2s ease, transform .2s ease;
  }
  .extras-menu.open .extras-dropdown{ opacity:1; pointer-events:auto; transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0); }
  .extras-dropdown button{
    background:none; border:none; text-align:left; padding: 10px 14px; border-radius:4px;
    font-family:'Cormorant Garamond', serif; font-style:italic; font-size:1rem; color: var(--ink);
  }
  .extras-dropdown button:hover{ background: var(--beige-deep); color: var(--seal); }

  /* photos */
  .photos-card{ max-width: 560px; text-align:center; }
  .photo-grid{
    display:grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(110px, 1fr));
    gap: 10px; margin-top: 24px; max-height: 40vh; overflow-y:auto;
  }
  .photo-grid img{
    width:100%; aspect-ratio: 1; object-fit: cover;
    border: 1px solid var(--paper-shadow); border-radius: 3px;
    box-shadow: 0 6px 14px -8px rgba(59,50,38,0.4);
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: transform .15s ease;
  }
  .photo-grid img:hover{ transform: scale(1.04); }
  .photo-grid .empty-note{
    grid-column: 1 / -1; font-size:.85rem; color: var(--ink-soft); font-style:italic; padding: 20px 0;
  }

  /* photo lightbox */
  .lightbox-inner{
    background-color: var(--paper); background-image: var(--grain); background-size: 3px 3px;
    padding: 30px; max-width: 90vw; max-height: 88vh;
    position: relative; box-shadow: 0 30px 60px -20px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
    display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; gap:16px;
    transform: translateY(28px) scale(.97); opacity:0; transition: all .4s ease;
  }
  #photoLightbox.in .lightbox-inner{ transform: translateY(0) scale(1); opacity:1; }
  #lightboxImg{
    max-width: 100%; max-height: 65vh; object-fit: contain;
    border: 1px solid var(--paper-shadow);
  }
  #lightboxDeleteBtn{ color: var(--seal); border-color: var(--seal); }
  #lightboxDeleteBtn:hover{ background: var(--seal); color:#fff; }

  .garden-screen{
    position:fixed; inset:0; background: var(--beige);
    display:none; z-index:65; opacity:0; transition: opacity .4s ease, background-color 1.4s ease;
    overflow:hidden; cursor: pointer;
    touch-action: manipulation;
  }
  .garden-screen.show{ display:block; }
  .garden-screen.show.in{ opacity:1; }
  .garden-hint{
    position:absolute; top:44px; left:50%; transform:translateX(-50%);
    font-family:'Cormorant Garamond', serif; font-style:italic; color: var(--ink-soft);
    font-size:1rem; pointer-events:none; text-align:center; width:80%;
  }
  .garden-screen .soil{
    position:absolute; bottom:0; left:0; right:0; height:70px;
    background: linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent, rgba(107,93,73,0.22));
    pointer-events:none;
  }

  /* garden intro — bouquet reveal */
  .garden-intro{
    position:fixed; inset:0; background: var(--beige);
    display:none; z-index:66; opacity:0; transition: opacity .4s ease;
    flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    cursor:pointer; touch-action: manipulation;
  }
  .garden-intro.show{ display:flex; }
  .garden-intro.show.in{ opacity:1; }
  .intro-wiper{
    position:relative; width: min(300px, 70vw); overflow:hidden;
    clip-path: inset(0 0 100% 0);
    animation: introReveal 3s ease forwards;
    filter: drop-shadow(0 14px 26px rgba(59,50,38,0.35));
  }
  .intro-wiper img{ display:block; width:100%; height:auto; }
  @keyframes introReveal{ to{ clip-path: inset(0 0 0% 0); } }
  .intro-sweep{
    position:absolute; left:0; right:0; top:0; height:16px;
    background: linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent, rgba(255,215,140,0.85), transparent);
    filter: blur(3px);
    animation: sweepMove 3s ease forwards;
  }
  @keyframes sweepMove{ from{ top:0%; } to{ top:100%; } }
  .intro-prompt{
    margin-top: 26px; opacity:0;
    font-family:'Cormorant Garamond', serif; font-style:italic; color: var(--ink-soft);
    font-size: 1rem;
    animation: introPromptIn .8s ease forwards;
    animation-play-state: paused;
  }
  .intro-prompt.show{ animation-play-state: running; }
  @keyframes introPromptIn{ to{ opacity:1; } }

  .flower-wrap{
    position:absolute; bottom:0; pointer-events:none;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    animation: flowerFade .9s ease-in forwards;
    animation-delay: 2.7s;
  }
  @keyframes flowerFade{
    to{ opacity:0; transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(8px) rotate(6deg); }
  }
  .flower-svg .stem{ fill:none; }
  .flower-svg .leaf{
    transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: center;
    opacity:0; transform: scale(0);
    animation: leafPop .4s ease-out forwards;
    animation-delay: .3s;
  }
  .flower-svg .leaf-r{ animation-delay: .4s; }
  @keyframes leafPop{ to{ opacity:1; transform: scale(1); } }
  .flower-svg .bloom{
    transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: center;
    opacity:0; transform: scale(0);
    animation: bloomPop .5s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1) forwards;
    animation-delay: .55s;
    filter: drop-shadow(0 0 4px rgba(255,205,120,0.55)) drop-shadow(0 0 9px rgba(255,180,90,0.35));
  }
  @keyframes bloomPop{ to{ opacity:1; transform: scale(1); } }
  .flower-svg .glow-halo{
    filter: blur(7px);
    animation: glowPulse 2.2s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
  }
  @keyframes glowPulse{
    from{ opacity: .35; }
    to{ opacity: .65; }
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<div id="dust"></div>
<div id="ambientGlow"></div>
<button id="soundToggle" title="Toggle sound">♪</button>

<!-- LOCK SCREEN -->
<div id="lock">
  <div class="lock-half lock-left">
    <div class="pinned-note">
      <h1>A note, before you go in</h1>
      <p id="noteText">There's something I've been wanting to tell you.
I could've just sent a message —
but after [7] months of knowing you, I thought you deserved
something a little more special.

Take your time opening these.</p>
      <div class="sign">— Mr. Spenza</div>
    </div>
    <div class="lock-flowers" id="lockFlowersLeft"></div>
  </div>
  <div class="lock-half lock-right">
    <div class="lock-flowers" id="lockFlowersRight"></div>
    <div class="pass-wrap">
      <div class="eyebrow">Enter the passcode</div>
      <h2>Four numbers, one key</h2>

      <div class="padlock" id="padlock">
        <div class="shackle" id="shackle"></div>
        <div class="lock-body">
          <div class="wheels">
            <div class="wheel" data-i="0">
              <button class="wheel-btn up" data-dir="1">▲</button>
              <div class="wheel-digit">0</div>
              <button class="wheel-btn down" data-dir="-1">▼</button>
            </div>
            <div class="wheel" data-i="1">
              <button class="wheel-btn up" data-dir="1">▲</button>
              <div class="wheel-digit">0</div>
              <button class="wheel-btn down" data-dir="-1">▼</button>
            </div>
            <div class="wheel" data-i="2">
              <button class="wheel-btn up" data-dir="1">▲</button>
              <div class="wheel-digit">0</div>
              <button class="wheel-btn down" data-dir="-1">▼</button>
            </div>
            <div class="wheel" data-i="3">
              <button class="wheel-btn up" data-dir="1">▲</button>
              <div class="wheel-digit">0</div>
              <button class="wheel-btn down" data-dir="-1">▼</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <button class="go-btn" id="tryLockBtn" style="margin-top:22px;">Try it</button>

      <div class="hint">it all started with this<br><span class="hint-sub">if you don't really know, just ask me for a clue</span></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- LETTERS SCREEN -->
<div id="letters">
  <h1>Seven little notes</h1>
  <div class="sub">open them one at a time</div>
  <div class="progress" id="progress"></div>
  <div class="desk" id="desk"></div>
  <div class="extras-menu">
    <button id="extrasToggle">more <span class="chev">⌄</span></button>
    <div class="extras-dropdown" id="extrasDropdown">
      <button id="askLink">Ask me anything</button>
      <button id="gardenLink">A little garden</button>
      <button id="photosLink">Photos</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<div id="overlay">
  <div class="letter-paper" id="letterPaper">
    <button class="close-btn" id="closeBtn">✕</button>
    <div id="letterContent"></div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ASK ME ANYTHING SCREEN -->
<div id="askScreen" class="ask-screen">
  <div class="ask-card">
    <button class="close-btn" id="askCloseBtn">✕</button>
    <h2>Ask me anything</h2>
    <p class="ask-sub">Whatever's on your mind — I'll answer you properly.</p>
    <textarea id="askText" rows="5" placeholder="Type your question here..."></textarea>
    <button class="go-btn" id="askSendBtn">Send</button>
    <div class="answer-msg" id="askMsg"></div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- GARDEN INTRO (bouquet reveal) -->
<div id="gardenIntro" class="garden-intro">
  <button class="close-btn" id="gardenIntroCloseBtn">✕</button>
  <div class="intro-wiper" id="introWiper">
    <div class="intro-sweep" id="introSweep"></div>
    <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="">
  </div>
  <p class="intro-prompt" id="introPrompt">tap to step inside</p>
</div>

<!-- LITTLE GARDEN SCREEN -->
<div id="gardenScreen" class="garden-screen">
  <button class="close-btn" id="gardenCloseBtn">✕</button>
  <p class="garden-hint">tap anywhere — something will grow</p>
  <div class="soil"></div>
</div>

<!-- PHOTOS SCREEN -->
<div id="photosScreen" class="ask-screen">
  <div class="ask-card photos-card">
    <button class="close-btn" id="photosCloseBtn">✕</button>
    <h2>Photos</h2>
    <p class="ask-sub">You can add photos here, madam.</p>
    <input type="file" id="photoInput" accept="image/*" hidden>
    <button class="go-btn" id="photoUploadBtn">Add a photo</button>
    <div class="answer-msg" id="photoMsg"></div>
    <div class="photo-grid" id="photoGrid"></div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- PHOTO LIGHTBOX -->
<div id="photoLightbox" class="ask-screen">
  <div class="lightbox-inner">
    <button class="close-btn" id="lightboxCloseBtn">✕</button>
    <img id="lightboxImg" src="" alt="">
    <button class="go-btn ghost" id="lightboxDeleteBtn">Delete this photo</button>
  </div>
</div>

<div id="confetti"></div>

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2"></script>
<script>

  /* ---------------- LOCK (combination wheels) ---------------- */
  const CODE = "0725";
  const lock = document.getElementById("lock");
  const padlock = document.getElementById("padlock");
  const shackle = document.getElementById("shackle");
  const wheelEls = document.querySelectorAll(".wheel");
  const wheelDigits = [0, 0, 0, 0];
  document.body.classList.add("lock-active");

  function renderWheel(i){
    const digitEl = wheelEls[i].querySelector(".wheel-digit");
    digitEl.textContent = wheelDigits[i];
    digitEl.classList.remove("bump");
    void digitEl.offsetWidth; // restart animation
    digitEl.classList.add("bump");
  }

  wheelEls.forEach((wheelEl, i)=>{
    wheelEl.querySelector(".up").addEventListener("click", ()=>{
      wheelDigits[i] = (wheelDigits[i] + 1) % 10;
      renderWheel(i);
      playClick();
    });
    wheelEl.querySelector(".down").addEventListener("click", ()=>{
      wheelDigits[i] = (wheelDigits[i] + 9) % 10;
      renderWheel(i);
      playClick();
    });
  });

  function tryUnlock(){
    const entered = wheelDigits.join("");
    if(entered === CODE){
      shackle.classList.add("open");
      playUnlockChime();
      setTimeout(()=>{
        lock.classList.add("hidden");
        document.body.classList.remove("lock-active");
        setTimeout(()=> lock.classList.add("gone"), 950);
        startPetalDrift();
        startButterflies();
      }, 500);
    } else {
      padlock.classList.add("error");
      playWrongBuzz();
      setTimeout(()=> padlock.classList.remove("error"), 500);
    }
  }
  document.getElementById("tryLockBtn").addEventListener("click", tryUnlock);

  /* ---------------- SOUND (synthesized, no external files) ---------------- */
  let soundOn = false;
  let audioCtx = null;
  const soundBtn = document.getElementById("soundToggle");
  soundBtn.addEventListener("click", ()=>{
    soundOn = !soundOn;
    soundBtn.classList.toggle("on", soundOn);
    if(soundOn && !audioCtx){
      audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
    }
  });

  function playRustle(){
    if(!soundOn || !audioCtx) return;
    const duration = 0.35;
    const bufferSize = audioCtx.sampleRate * duration;
    const buffer = audioCtx.createBuffer(1, bufferSize, audioCtx.sampleRate);
    const data = buffer.getChannelData(0);
    for(let i=0;i<bufferSize;i++){
      data[i] = (Math.random()*2 - 1) * (1 - i/bufferSize);
    }
    const noise = audioCtx.createBufferSource();
    noise.buffer = buffer;
    const filter = audioCtx.createBiquadFilter();
    filter.type = "highpass";
    filter.frequency.value = 800;
    const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
    gain.gain.value = 0.18;
    noise.connect(filter).connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
    noise.start();
  }

  function playTone(freq, duration, type, startTime, gainPeak){
    if(!soundOn || !audioCtx) return;
    const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
    const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
    osc.type = type || "sine";
    osc.frequency.value = freq;
    const t0 = audioCtx.currentTime + (startTime || 0);
    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, t0);
    gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(gainPeak || 0.12, t0 + 0.02);
    gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t0 + duration);
    osc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
    osc.start(t0);
    osc.stop(t0 + duration + 0.02);
  }

  function playClick(){
    playTone(720, 0.05, "sine", 0, 0.08);
  }

  function playUnlockChime(){
    if(!soundOn || !audioCtx) return;
    playTone(523.25, 0.18, "sine", 0, 0.12);
    playTone(659.25, 0.18, "sine", 0.09, 0.12);
    playTone(783.99, 0.28, "sine", 0.18, 0.14);
  }

  function playWrongBuzz(){
    if(!soundOn || !audioCtx) return;
    const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
    const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
    osc.type = "square";
    osc.frequency.value = 140;
    const t0 = audioCtx.currentTime;
    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, t0);
    gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.08, t0 + 0.02);
    gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t0 + 0.25);
    osc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
    osc.start(t0);
    osc.stop(t0 + 0.27);
  }

  function playGrow(){
    if(!soundOn || !audioCtx) return;
    const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
    const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
    osc.type = "sine";
    const t0 = audioCtx.currentTime;
    osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(180, t0);
    osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(520, t0 + 0.5);
    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, t0);
    gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.09, t0 + 0.08);
    gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t0 + 0.55);
    osc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
    osc.start(t0);
    osc.stop(t0 + 0.6);
  }

  function playSend(){
    playTone(880, 0.12, "sine", 0, 0.1);
    playTone(1174.66, 0.16, "sine", 0.08, 0.1);
  }

  /* ---------------- EXTRAS DROPDOWN ---------------- */
  const extrasMenu = document.querySelector(".extras-menu");
  const extrasToggle = document.getElementById("extrasToggle");
  extrasToggle.addEventListener("click", (e)=>{
    e.stopPropagation();
    extrasMenu.classList.toggle("open");
  });
  document.addEventListener("click", (e)=>{
    if(extrasMenu.classList.contains("open") && !e.target.closest(".extras-menu")){
      extrasMenu.classList.remove("open");
    }
  });
  document.querySelectorAll(".extras-dropdown button").forEach(btn=>{
    btn.addEventListener("click", ()=> extrasMenu.classList.remove("open"));
  });

  /* ---------------- DUST ---------------- */
  const dustWrap = document.getElementById("dust");
  for(let i=0;i<18;i++){
    const m = document.createElement("div");
    m.className = "mote";
    m.style.left = Math.random()*100 + "vw";
    m.style.animationDuration = (14 + Math.random()*10) + "s";
    m.style.animationDelay = (Math.random()*14) + "s";
    dustWrap.appendChild(m);
  }

  /* ---------------- SPARSE BACKGROUND PETAL DRIFT (envelope page only) ---------------- */
  let petalDriftTimer = null;
  const petalTones = ["var(--rose)", "var(--gold)"];

  function startPetalDrift(){
    if(petalDriftTimer) return;
    scheduleNextPetal();
  }
  function scheduleNextPetal(){
    const delay = 3200 + Math.random() * 2600;
    petalDriftTimer = setTimeout(()=>{
      const modalOpen =
        overlay.classList.contains("show") ||
        askScreen.classList.contains("show") ||
        gardenScreen.classList.contains("show");
      if(!modalOpen) spawnBgPetal();
      scheduleNextPetal();
    }, delay);
  }
  function spawnBgPetal(){
    const el = document.createElement("div");
    el.className = "bg-petal";
    const size = 8 + Math.random() * 5;
    el.style.left = Math.random() * 100 + "vw";
    el.style.width = size + "px";
    el.style.height = (size * 1.35) + "px";
    el.style.background = petalTones[Math.floor(Math.random() * petalTones.length)];
    const duration = 10 + Math.random() * 6;

  /* ---------------- OCCASIONAL GLOWING BUTTERFLY ---------------- */
  let butterflyTimer = null;
  let butterflyCounter = 0;
  const butterflyTones = [
    { outer: "#E0973B", inner: "#FDE1A0" },
    { outer: "#D9834A", inner: "#F7C98C" },
    { outer: "#B58A3D", inner: "#EAD08C" }
  ];

  function startButterflies(){
    if(butterflyTimer) return;
    scheduleNextButterfly();
  }
  function scheduleNextButterfly(){
    const delay = 16000 + Math.random() * 14000;
    butterflyTimer = setTimeout(()=>{
      const modalOpen =
        overlay.classList.contains("show") ||
        askScreen.classList.contains("show") ||
        gardenScreen.classList.contains("show") ||
        photosScreen.classList.contains("show");
      if(!modalOpen) spawnButterfly();
      scheduleNextButterfly();
    }, delay);
  }
  function spawnButterfly(){
    butterflyCounter++;
    const gid = `wingGrad-${butterflyCounter}`;
    const tone = butterflyTones[Math.floor(Math.random() * butterflyTones.length)];
    const el = document.createElement("div");
    el.className = "butterfly";
    const startY = 10 + Math.random() * 70;
    el.style.top = startY + "vh";
    el.style.left = "-40px";
    const size = 26 + Math.random() * 10;
    el.innerHTML = `
      <svg viewBox="0 0 60 40" width="${size}" height="${size * 40/60}">
        <defs>
          <radialGradient id="${gid}" cx="35%" cy="30%" r="75%">
            <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFF3D0"/>
            <stop offset="55%" stop-color="${tone.outer}"/>
            <stop offset="100%" stop-color="${tone.inner}"/>
          </radialGradient>
        </defs>
        <g class="wing wing-l">
          <path d="M30 20 C 10 0, -5 5, 5 22 C 10 30, 25 28, 30 20 Z" fill="url(#${gid})"/>
        </g>
        <g class="wing wing-r">
          <path d="M30 20 C 50 0, 65 5, 55 22 C 50 30, 35 28, 30 20 Z" fill="url(#${gid})"/>
        </g>
        <ellipse cx="30" cy="20" rx="2" ry="8" fill="#7a5a2a"/>
      </svg>
    `;
    const duration = 10 + Math.random() * 6;
    el.style.animationDuration = duration + "s";
    document.body.appendChild(el);
    setTimeout(()=> el.remove(), duration * 1000 + 200);
  }

  /* ---------------- MOUSE-REACTIVE PARALLAX (dust + envelopes) ---------------- */

  window.addEventListener("mousemove", (e)=>{
    if(mouseRAF) return;
    mouseRAF = true;
    requestAnimationFrame(()=>{
      const fx = (e.clientX / window.innerWidth - 0.5);
      const fy = (e.clientY / window.innerHeight - 0.5);
      dustWrap.style.transform = `translate(${fx * 14}px, ${fy * 14}px)`;
      if(deskEl) deskEl.style.transform = `translate(${fx * -8}px, ${fy * -6}px)`;
      mouseRAF = false;
    });
  });

    lastTrail = now;
    const dot = document.createElement("div");
    dot.className = "trail-dot";
    dot.style.left = e.clientX + "px";
    dot.style.top = e.clientY + "px";

  function hexLerp(hexA, hexB, t){
    const a = [1,3,5].map(i => parseInt(hexA.substr(i,2),16));
    const b = [1,3,5].map(i => parseInt(hexB.substr(i,2),16));
    const c = a.map((v,i)=> Math.round(v + (b[i]-v)*t));
    return "#" + c.map(v=> v.toString(16).padStart(2,"0")).join("");
  }

  async function loadGallery(){
    const client = getSupabase();
    photoGrid.innerHTML = "";
    if(!client){
      photoGrid.innerHTML = `<div class="empty-note">Photo sharing isn't set up yet.</div>`;
      return;
    }
    photoMsg.textContent = "";
    const { data, error } = await client.storage.from(PHOTOS_BUCKET).list("", {
      sortBy: { column: "created_at", order: "desc" }
    });
    if(error || !data || data.length === 0){
      photoGrid.innerHTML = `<div class="empty-note">No photos yet — add the first one.</div>`;
      return;
    }
    data.forEach(item=>{
      if(!item.name) return;
      const { data: pub } = client.storage.from(PHOTOS_BUCKET).getPublicUrl(item.name);
      const img = document.createElement("img");
      img.src = pub.publicUrl;
      img.loading = "lazy";
      img.addEventListener("click", ()=> openLightbox(pub.publicUrl, item.name));
      photoGrid.appendChild(img);
    });
  }

    lightboxDeleteBtn.textContent = "Deleting...";

  /* ---------------- STATE ---------------- */
  const PROGRESS_KEY = "seven-notes-progress-v1";
  let unlockedCount = 1;     // how many envelopes are openable
  let completedCount = 0;    // how many have been opened & closed
  let bonusRevealed = false;

  function loadProgress(){
    try{
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(PROGRESS_KEY);
      if(!raw) return;
      const saved = JSON.parse(raw);
      if(typeof saved.unlockedCount === "number") unlockedCount = Math.max(unlockedCount, saved.unlockedCount);
      if(typeof saved.completedCount === "number") completedCount = Math.max(completedCount, saved.completedCount);
      if(saved.bonusRevealed) bonusRevealed = true;
    } catch(e){ /* corrupted or unavailable storage — just start fresh */ }
  }
  function saveProgress(){
    try{
      localStorage.setItem(PROGRESS_KEY, JSON.stringify({ unlockedCount, completedCount, bonusRevealed }));
    } catch(e){ /* storage unavailable (private browsing etc) — fail silently */ }
  }
  loadProgress();

  const desk = document.getElementById("desk");

  const romanNum = ["I","II","III","IV","V","VI","VII"];

  function buildProgress(){
    progressEl.innerHTML = "";

      const node = document.createElement("div");
      node.className = "p-node";
      if(i < completedCount) node.classList.add("done");
      else if(i === completedCount) node.classList.add("current");
      node.textContent = i < completedCount ? "✓" : r;
      progressEl.appendChild(node);
      if(i < romanNum.length - 1){
        const line = document.createElement("div");
        line.className = "p-line" + (i < completedCount ? " done" : "");
        progressEl.appendChild(line);
      }
    });
    updateAmbiance();

        ${locked ? '<div class="lockicon">🔒</div>' : ''}
        <div class="num">Note ${i+1}</div>`;
      env.addEventListener("click", ()=>{ if(!locked) openEnvelope(i, env); });
      desk.appendChild(env);
    });
    if(bonusRevealed){
      const env = document.createElement("div");
      env.className = "envelope bonus reveal-bonus";
      env.innerHTML = `<div class="seal">✦</div><div class="num">Open whenever you miss me</div>`;
      env.addEventListener("click", ()=> openEnvelope(-1, env));

  function closeGarden(){

    setTimeout(()=>{
      gardenScreen.classList.remove("show");
      gardenScreen.querySelectorAll(".flower-wrap").forEach(f => f.remove());

    spawnFlower(e.clientX, e.clientY);
  });

  function quadPoint(p0, p1, p2, t){
    const mt = 1 - t;
    return {
      x: mt*mt*p0.x + 2*mt*t*p1.x + t*t*p2.x,
      y: mt*mt*p0.y + 2*mt*t*p1.y + t*t*p2.y
    };
  }
  function cubicPoint(p0, p1, p2, p3, t){
    const mt = 1 - t;
    return {
      x: mt*mt*mt*p0.x + 3*mt*mt*t*p1.x + 3*mt*t*t*p2.x + t*t*t*p3.x,
      y: mt*mt*mt*p0.y + 3*mt*mt*t*p1.y + 3*mt*t*t*p2.y + t*t*t*p3.y
    };
  }

  function spawnFlower(x, y){
    const flower = FLOWER_IMAGES[Math.floor(Math.random() * FLOWER_IMAGES.length)];
    playGrow();

    // stem grows from the soil up to roughly where you tapped
    const groundY = window.innerHeight - 26;
    const rawHeight = groundY - y;
    const stemLen = Math.max(80, Math.min(rawHeight, window.innerHeight * 0.72));
    const svgH = stemLen + 60;
    const canvasW = 120;
    const baseX = 60;
    const bottom = { x: baseX, y: svgH - 8 };
    const top = 42;

    // real S-curve: two control points pulling opposite directions, so it sways one way then the other
    const bend1 = (Math.random() * 36 - 18);
    const bend2 = -bend1 * (0.55 + Math.random() * 0.5) + (Math.random() * 8 - 4);
    const tipSway = Math.max(-20, Math.min(20, bend2 * 0.45 + (Math.random() * 8 - 4)));

    const ctrl1 = { x: baseX + bend1, y: bottom.y - (bottom.y - top) * 0.32 };
    const ctrl2 = { x: baseX + bend2, y: bottom.y - (bottom.y - top) * 0.68 };
    const tip = { x: baseX + tipSway, y: top };

    const leaf1 = cubicPoint(bottom, ctrl1, ctrl2, tip, 0.38);
    const leaf2 = cubicPoint(bottom, ctrl1, ctrl2, tip, 0.7);

    const headSize = 58;

    const wrap = document.createElement("div");
    wrap.className = "flower-wrap";
    wrap.style.left = x + "px";
    wrap.innerHTML = `
      <svg class="flower-svg" viewBox="0 0 ${canvasW} ${svgH}" width="64" height="${Math.round(svgH * (64/canvasW))}">
        <path class="stem" d="M ${bottom.x} ${bottom.y} C ${ctrl1.x} ${ctrl1.y} ${ctrl2.x} ${ctrl2.y} ${tip.x} ${tip.y}"
              stroke="var(--sage)" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        <ellipse class="leaf leaf-l" cx="${leaf1.x}" cy="${leaf1.y}" rx="12" ry="6" fill="var(--sage)" transform="rotate(-28 ${leaf1.x} ${leaf1.y})"/>
        <ellipse class="leaf leaf-r" cx="${leaf2.x}" cy="${leaf2.y}" rx="12" ry="6" fill="var(--sage)" transform="rotate(28 ${leaf2.x} ${leaf2.y})"/>
        <g class="bloom">
          <circle class="glow-halo" cx="${tip.x}" cy="${tip.y - 6}" r="22" fill="${flower.glow}"/>
          <image href="${flower.src}" x="${tip.x - headSize/2}" y="${tip.y - headSize*0.62}"
                 width="${headSize}" height="${headSize}" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"/>
        </g>
      </svg>
    `;
    gardenScreen.appendChild(wrap);

    // draw the curved stem in, like it's actually growing along its path
    const stemPath = wrap.querySelector(".stem");
    const len = stemPath.getTotalLength();
    stemPath.style.strokeDasharray = len;
    stemPath.style.strokeDashoffset = len;
    const growDuration = Math.min(1100, Math.max(450, len * 1.1));
    stemPath.animate(
      [{ strokeDashoffset: len }, { strokeDashoffset: 0 }],
      { duration: growDuration, easing: "ease-out", fill: "forwards" }
    );

    const leafDelay = growDuration * 0.45;
    const bloomDelay = growDuration * 0.9;
    wrap.querySelector(".leaf-l").style.animationDelay = leafDelay + "ms";
    wrap.querySelector(".leaf-r").style.animationDelay = (leafDelay + 90) + "ms";
    wrap.querySelector(".bloom").style.animationDelay = bloomDelay + "ms";

    const holdUntilFade = bloomDelay + 500 + 2300;
    wrap.style.animationDelay = holdUntilFade + "ms";
    setTimeout(()=> wrap.remove(), holdUntilFade + 900 + 200);
  }

  /* ---------------- OPEN / MODAL ---------------- */
  const overlay = document.getElementById("overlay");
  const letterContent = document.getElementById("letterContent");
  let typeTimer = null;

  function openEnvelope(index, envEl){
    envEl.classList.add("opening");
    playRustle();
    setTimeout(()=>{
      if(index === letters.length - 1) showPreFinal();
      else if(index === -1) renderLetterBody(bonusLetter, null);
      else renderLetterBody(letters[index], index);
      overlay.classList.add("show");
      requestAnimationFrame(()=> overlay.classList.add("in"));
    }, 420);
  }

  function typewrite(el, text, done){
    el.textContent = "";
    let i = 0;
    clearInterval(typeTimer);
    typeTimer = setInterval(()=>{
      el.textContent += text[i];
      i++;
      if(i >= text.length){ clearInterval(typeTimer); if(done) done(); }
    }, 18);
  }

  function renderLetterBody(letter, index){
    const isBonus = (index === null);
    const isLast = (index === letters.length - 1);
    letterContent.innerHTML = `
      <h2>${letter.title}</h2>
      <div class="body-text" id="bodyText"></div>
      <div id="unlockRow" style="display:none;">
        ${(!isBonus && !isLast) ? '<button class="go-btn" id="unlockNextBtn">Unlock next letter →</button>' : ''}
        ${isBonus ? '<div class="next-hint">come back whenever you miss me</div>' : ''}
      </div>
      <button class="skip-btn" id="skipBtn">skip animation</button>
    `;
    const bodyEl = document.getElementById("bodyText");
    const unlockRow = document.getElementById("unlockRow");
    function reveal(){ unlockRow.style.display = "block"; }
    typewrite(bodyEl, letter.body, reveal);
    document.getElementById("skipBtn").addEventListener("click", ()=>{
      clearInterval(typeTimer);
      bodyEl.textContent = letter.body;
      reveal();
    });
    if(!isBonus && !isLast){
      document.getElementById("unlockNextBtn").addEventListener("click", ()=>{
        markComplete(index, false);
        buildProgress();
        buildEnvelopes();
        closeOverlay();
      });
    }
    letterContent.dataset.index = index === null ? "" : index;
  }

  function showPreFinal(){
    letterContent.innerHTML = `
      <div class="pre-final">
        <p>Before you read this...</p>
        <p style="opacity:.75;">Thank you for opening all six letters.</p>
        <button class="go-btn" id="oneLastThing">One last thing →</button>
      </div>
    `;
    document.getElementById("oneLastThing").addEventListener("click", ()=>{
      renderFinalLetter();
    });
  }

  function renderFinalLetter(){
    const letter = letters[letters.length - 1];
    letterContent.innerHTML = `
      <h2>${letter.title}</h2>
      <div class="body-text" id="bodyText"></div>
      <div class="question-block" id="qBlock" style="display:none;">
        <div class="q">So... can I court you?</div>
        <div class="q-buttons">
          <button class="go-btn" id="yesBtn">Yes, you can ❤️</button>
          <button class="go-btn ghost" id="noBtn">Let me think about it</button>
        </div>
        <div class="answer-msg" id="answerMsg"></div>
      </div>
      <button class="skip-btn" id="skipBtn">skip animation</button>
    `;
    const bodyEl = document.getElementById("bodyText");
    const qBlock = document.getElementById("qBlock");
    function reveal(){
      qBlock.style.display = "block";
    }
    typewrite(bodyEl, letter.body, reveal);
    document.getElementById("skipBtn").addEventListener("click", ()=>{
      clearInterval(typeTimer);
      bodyEl.textContent = letter.body;
      reveal();
    });

    setTimeout(()=>{
      const yesBtn = document.getElementById("yesBtn");
      const noBtn = document.getElementById("noBtn");
      const msg = document.getElementById("answerMsg");
      const lastIndex = letters.length - 1;
      if(yesBtn) yesBtn.addEventListener("click", ()=>{
        msg.textContent = "Then I guess this is where a new chapter begins. Thank you for giving me a chance.";
        celebrate();
        markComplete(lastIndex, true);
        notifyMe("She said YES 🎉", "She agreed to let you court her! (Date & activity may still be coming — check for a follow-up notification.)");
        yesBtn.disabled = true; noBtn.disabled = true;
        yesBtn.style.opacity = .5; noBtn.style.opacity = .5;
        const cont = document.createElement("button");
        cont.className = "go-btn";
        cont.style.marginTop = "16px";
        cont.textContent = "Continue →";
        cont.addEventListener("click", renderDateInvite);
        qBlock.appendChild(cont);
      });
      if(noBtn) noBtn.addEventListener("click", ()=>{
        msg.textContent = "Of course. Take all the time you need. No pressure.";
        markComplete(lastIndex, false);
        notifyMe("She said: let her think about it", "No rush — she asked for more time before answering.");
        yesBtn.disabled = true; noBtn.disabled = true;
        yesBtn.style.opacity = .5; noBtn.style.opacity = .5;
      });
    }, 50);
  }

  /* ---------------- POST-YES: DATE INVITE FLOW ---------------- */
  let selectedDate = null;
  let calView = new Date();

  function renderDateInvite(){
    letterContent.innerHTML = `
      <div class="pre-final date-invite">
        <p>Since you said yes...</p>
        <p style="opacity:.8;">Would you let me take you on a small date sometime?</p>
        <button class="go-btn" id="whenFreeBtn">When are you free? →</button>
        <button class="go-btn ghost" id="maybeLaterBtn">Maybe later</button>
      </div>
    `;
    document.getElementById("whenFreeBtn").addEventListener("click", ()=>{
      calView = new Date();
      renderCalendarStep();
    });
    document.getElementById("maybeLaterBtn").addEventListener("click", ()=>{
      letterContent.innerHTML = `
        <div class="pre-final date-invite">
          <p>Whenever you're ready.</p>
          <p style="opacity:.75;">No pressure — I'll be here.</p>
        </div>
      `;
    });
  }

  function renderCalendarStep(){
    const year = calView.getFullYear(), month = calView.getMonth();
    const monthName = calView.toLocaleString('default', { month: 'long' });
    const firstDay = new Date(year, month, 1).getDay();
    const daysInMonth = new Date(year, month + 1, 0).getDate();
    const today = new Date(); today.setHours(0,0,0,0);
    const thisMonthStart = new Date(today.getFullYear(), today.getMonth(), 1);
    const canGoPrev = new Date(year, month, 1) > thisMonthStart;

    let cells = '';
    for(let i=0;i<firstDay;i++) cells += `<div class="cal-day empty"></div>`;
    for(let d=1; d<=daysInMonth; d++){
      const cellDate = new Date(year, month, d);
      const disabled = cellDate < today;
      cells += `<button class="cal-day${disabled?' disabled':''}" data-day="${d}" ${disabled?'disabled':''}>${d}</button>`;
    }

    letterContent.innerHTML = `
      <div class="pre-final date-invite">
        <p>Since you said yes...</p>
        <p style="opacity:.8;">When are you free?</p>
        <div class="calendar">
          <div class="cal-header">
            <button class="cal-nav" id="prevMonth" ${canGoPrev ? '' : 'disabled style="opacity:.3;cursor:not-allowed;"'}>‹</button>
            <span>${monthName} ${year}</span>
            <button class="cal-nav" id="nextMonth">›</button>
          </div>
          <div class="cal-weekdays"><span>Su</span><span>Mo</span><span>Tu</span><span>We</span><span>Th</span><span>Fr</span><span>Sa</span></div>
          <div class="cal-grid">${cells}</div>
        </div>
        <button class="go-btn ghost" id="laterBtn" style="margin-top:16px;">Not sure yet — choose later</button>
      </div>
    `;

    if(canGoPrev){
      document.getElementById("prevMonth").addEventListener("click", ()=>{
        calView = new Date(year, month - 1, 1);
        renderCalendarStep();
      });
    }
    document.getElementById("nextMonth").addEventListener("click", ()=>{
      calView = new Date(year, month + 1, 1);
      renderCalendarStep();
    });
    document.querySelectorAll(".cal-day:not(.empty):not(.disabled)").forEach(btn=>{
      btn.addEventListener("click", ()=>{
        selectedDate = new Date(year, month, parseInt(btn.dataset.day));
        renderActivityStep();
      });
    });
    document.getElementById("laterBtn").addEventListener("click", ()=>{
      selectedDate = null;
      renderActivityStep();
    });
  }

  function renderActivityStep(){
    const dateLabel = selectedDate
      ? selectedDate.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { weekday:'long', month:'long', day:'numeric' })
      : "we'll figure it out together";
    const options = [
      { key:'coffee', label:'Coffee / Drinks', desc:'Just sit somewhere, talk, and spend time together.' },
      { key:'food', label:'Food Trip', desc:'Find something affordable and eat together.' },
      { key:'movie', label:'Tara, ice cream?', desc:'Let\'s go grab ice cream together.' },
      { key:'walk', label:'Walk & Talk', desc:'Probably the cheapest one, but sometimes the best. (ihhh HAHAAHHAA)' },
      { key:'study', label:'Study Date', desc:'Study together, maybe get food after. (ayoko neto katamad HAHAHA joke)' },
      { key:'surprise', label:'Surprise Me', desc:"You choose — I'm down for whatever." }
    ];
    letterContent.innerHTML = `
      <div class="pre-final date-invite">
        <p>Okay, one more thing...</p>
        <p style="opacity:.8;">What kind of small date would you like?</p>
        <div class="activity-grid">
          ${options.map(o => `<button class="activity-option" data-key="${o.key}"><strong>${o.label}</strong><span>${o.desc}</span></button>`).join('')}
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
    document.querySelectorAll(".activity-option").forEach(btn=>{
      btn.addEventListener("click", ()=>{
        const chosen = options.find(o => o.key === btn.dataset.key);
        renderConfirmStep(dateLabel, chosen.label);
      });
    });
  }

  function renderConfirmStep(dateLabel, activityLabel){
    letterContent.innerHTML = `
      <div class="pre-final date-invite">
        <p style="margin-bottom:22px;">Your first small date</p>
        <div class="confirm-card">
          <div class="confirm-row"><span>Date</span><strong>${dateLabel}</strong></div>
          <div class="confirm-row"><span>Plan</span><strong>${activityLabel}</strong></div>
        </div>
        <p style="margin-top:22px; font-style:italic;">I'll be looking forward to it.</p>
        <button class="go-btn" id="saveBtn" style="margin-top:18px;">Save our plan</button>
        <div class="answer-msg" id="saveMsg"></div>
      </div>
    `;
    document.getElementById("saveBtn").addEventListener("click", ()=>{
      document.getElementById("saveMsg").textContent = "Saved. See you then.";
      notifyMe("Date's set!", `Date: ${dateLabel}\nPlan: ${activityLabel}`);
      celebrate();
    });
  }

  function markComplete(index, revealBonus){
    if(index + 1 > completedCount) completedCount = index + 1;
    const nextUnlock = Math.min(index + 2, letters.length);
    if(nextUnlock > unlockedCount) unlockedCount = nextUnlock;
    if(revealBonus) bonusRevealed = true;
    saveProgress();
  }

  document.getElementById("closeBtn").addEventListener("click", closeOverlay);
  overlay.addEventListener("click", (e)=>{ if(e.target === overlay) closeOverlay(); });

  function closeOverlay(){
    clearInterval(typeTimer);
    overlay.classList.remove("in");
    setTimeout(()=>{
      overlay.classList.remove("show");
      buildProgress();
      buildEnvelopes();
    }, 350);
  }

  /* ---------------- CELEBRATION ---------------- */
  function celebrate(){
    const wrap = document.getElementById("confetti");
    const petals = ["❤","✦","♡","❀"];
    for(let i=0;i<40;i++){
      const p = document.createElement("div");
      p.className = "petal";
      p.textContent = petals[Math.floor(Math.random()*petals.length)];
      p.style.left = Math.random()*100 + "vw";
      p.style.color = Math.random() > .5 ? "#A8543C" : "#B08D57";
      p.style.fontSize = (12 + Math.random()*14) + "px";
      p.style.animationDuration = (2.5 + Math.random()*2) + "s";
      wrap.appendChild(p);
      setTimeout(()=> p.remove(), 5000);
    }
  }
</script>
</body>
</html>
